question: is lily pasaporte a librarian? i need help finding sources for my research paper

body.answer:
The directory lists **Lili Pasaporte** (spelled with an “i”) as **Circulation Desk Supervisor** in Library Faculty & Staff; it does not give her the title “librarian.” Her office is LC-303A and her phone is (201) 684-7822. [1][5]

The Library offers research help:
1. Visit in person during Research Help Desk hours, or check the hours for virtual help. [2]
2. Research Help hours for Fall Semester (Aug. 26 – Dec. 15, 2026): Monday–Thursday, 9:00am–9:00pm; Friday, 9:00am–4:00pm; Saturday and Sunday, 3:00pm–6:00pm. [9]
3. Use chat during those hours; if Research Help is offline, email refdesk@ramapo.edu. [9]
4. You can also make a research appointment: https://libcal.ramapo.edu/appointments. [6][10]
5. Ask in person, submit a question through the Library’s form, call (201) 684-7574, text (201) 425-0095, or email via https://www.ramapo.edu/library/email-reference-form/. [10]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/staff/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/library-news/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/staff-directory/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/research-help-services/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/research-help-services/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/contact-form-aca/)

The dean of the Anisfield School of Business is Ed Petkus [1][2]. Your son can email him at epetkus@ramapo.edu [1][2]. The Anisfield School of Business office also lists ASB@ramapo.edu for the dean [3][4].

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/faculty/ed-petkus/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/home/comprehensive-academic-plan/resources/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/home/comprehensive-academic-plan/resources/)

question: Could you tell me how to reach Elizabeth Siecke in the library, and what her role there is?

body.answer:
Elizabeth Siecke is the Serials and Electronic Resources Librarian, Reference and Instruction, in Library Faculty & Staff. [1] Her directory lists office LC-319 and phone (201) 684-7318. [1] The staff-directory page also lists her liaison areas as OSS and Undergraduate Studies. [2] The directory lists an email contact form for her, but her email address is not published. [1][2]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/staff/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/staff-directory/)

question: Is Professor Regina Clark a good teacher? My son is deciding whether to take her writing class next fall.

body.answer:
The pages don’t verify whether Regina Clark is a good teacher or whether a writing class she teaches will be offered next fall. Her listed courses are Writing for Publication; Creative Non-fiction; Creative Writing; Senior Project: Writing; and Writing for Social Media. [1]
For help confirming next fall’s offerings, contact the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education Office at AHEOffice@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7365. [1]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/first-year/page-six/)

question: Good morning. Could you please let me know whether Professor Patel in the biology department is on campus today so we can stop by after our tour?

body.answer:
I don’t have verified information about whether Professor Patel is on campus today. The directory lists no one by that name [2]. The person named Julie Norflus-Good is a Professor of Teacher Education - Special Education, Director of the Master of Arts in Education, in the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education; her title does not name biology [2]. If you meant her, contact her at jgood@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7246; her office is E-220 [2]. For help locating someone in biology, contact the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office at SNHOffice@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7734, ASB-422 [1].

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-BIOL) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/ahe/faculty/julie-norflus-good/)

question: Who is the head of the computer science department, and what is the best phone number to call them?

body.answer:
The directory names no chair, head, convener, director, or dean for Computer Science. Computer Science faculty are in the School of Science, Nursing, and Health. [2] The directory identifies Benny Chan as Dean of SNH / Professor of Chemistry, but does not provide a phone number for him. [2] For help identifying the department head, contact the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office at (201) 684-7734 or SNHOffice@ramapo.edu. The directory does not specify a “best” number to call.

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/benny-chan/)
